status: engineering draft; see review reports for native ERC/DRC and release gates

01-inline: 9 A target / 10.8 A margin. Connector assemblies UNQUALIFIED. Force terminals parallel the USB ports.
02-sensing: PC and INLINE grounds stay separate. U2 is the only signal crossing. Kelvin routing is a PCB requirement.
03-supplies: JP1: 1-2 normal; 2-3 floating external 3.3 V. Fit ONE shunt. No isolated power converter is fitted.
04-usb-mcu: All circuits here are PC domain. No inline USB or CC signal reaches U3. Reporting connector is GCT USB4105.
05-debug: SWD VTref is a reference, not a power input. Headers use PC ground. Never jumper them to inline ground.
